assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original four-panel illustration sprite for an offline educational café website. Create a LANDSCAPE contact sheet, 1536 by 1024 pixels or the same 3:2 overall ratio. The image consists of EXACTLY FOUR equal rectangular panels arranged in an exact 2 by 2 grid, meeting at x=50% and y=50%. No gutters, divider lines, borders, rounded outer corners, interface, lettering, labels, words, numbers, logo, watermark or type of any kind. Each panel must be a complete independent scene, with all of its objects wholly inside that panel and a safe margin of at least 8% from its edges. The attached image is ONLY a reference for which café objects to depict; ignore its typography, webpage arrangement, UI, and quantity outside the four described panels.
CANONICAL SUBJECTS AND ORDER: Top left: café table scene at a three-quarter overhead angle with exactly ONE white espresso cup containing dark brown coffee and its white saucer in the front left, exactly ONE plain golden croissant on a plain white plate at the back right, and one neatly folded ivory napkin at the lower right. Keep the whole cup and handle, saucer, croissant, plate and napkin visible. No other food, mugs or cups, people or hands. Top right: exactly ONE white espresso cup containing dark brown coffee, visible handle at right, on its white saucer, centered at a three-quarter angle. Bottom left: exactly ONE plain golden croissant, centered, without additional food. Bottom right: exactly ONE translucent amber tea cup with a visible handle at right, containing amber tea, centered, without any other cup or food. The three individual product panels have quiet consistent backgrounds and generous negative space; keep their object scale comparable. This is the same café across four panels, with the same clear, recognizable real-world anatomy of cup handles, cup rims, saucers and croissant lamination. Do not turn food or cups into abstract symbols.
Style: sophisticated fresh expressive editorial illustration, large confident flat vector-like color fields with slight modeled volume. Palette: deep navy blue, crisp mint green, warm white, with golden brown preserved in pastry and coffee. Clean sculptural silhouettes, blue and mint background geometry, airy modern rhythm. The white ceramic cups and golden croissant stay naturally recognizable. No extra objects.
